raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms and findings, including abdominal distension, abdominal pain, diarrhea, weight loss, decreased stool caliber, and a palpable mass in the left lower quadrant, are consistent with a sigmoid colon cancer. The CT abdomen and flexible sigmoidoscopy results showing a large heterogeneous proximal sigmoid mass with near-complete luminal obstruction further support this diagnosis. The surgical pathology findings of a high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface and lymph node metastasis are also consistent with sigmoid colon cancer.

rejected.label: Colorectal adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: While this is a possible diagnosis, sigmoid colon cancer is more specific and directly references the location of the tumor, which is supported by the patient's symptoms and imaging findings.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: The surgical pathology findings do not support this diagnosis, as the tumor is described as a high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm rather than a gastrointestinal stromal tumor.

rejected.label: Lymphoma of the colon
rejected.why: The surgical pathology findings do not support this diagnosis, as the tumor is described as a high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface, which is not typical of lymphoma.

rejected.label: Poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma
rejected.why: The immunohistochemistry results do not support this diagnosis, as the tumor is negative for neuroendocrine markers such as CDX2 and chromogranin (not listed but typically included in neuroendocrine panels).

gold: Stage 3c (pT4a pN2a M0) Sarcomatoid Carcinoma of the sigmoid colon
